entry.title: New: Resolution 46 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
APPROVES THE AWARD OF FUNDS TO VARIOUS NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS FOR PROGRAMS ADDRESSING HOUSING AND HOMELESSNESS BY THE OFFICE OF HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

Proposes 15 grant awards to 9 different nonprofit organizations for a total of $10,500,000 in funding that was derived from Residential Tier Two property tax revenues.
